comment: SYMBOLS=S_unexplored:x. display.c docrt_flags() calls show_glyph(GLYPH_UNEXPLORED) on every unremembered square; its glyphinfo now differs from nul_gbuf's blank (display.c:2031-2044), so flush_screen() prints the x. The inventory corner menu is then dismissed: wintty.c docorner() clears each covered row and display.c row_refresh() repaints it, but its force test reads gg.gbuf[0][0], which only clear_glyph_buffer() writes and always with nul_gbuf, so the unexplored squares keep cl_end()'s blank, also after the next move.
